Name: DragonBeans from Arknights as Farm Animals
Author: EndlessPathB103
Description:
v3.0.6：修复厉钱影响完整度的bug，新增两个龙泡泡：小葱泡泡（绿色物品）、庄方宜泡泡（肥料、电池），调整大厨余泡泡的长寿面价格、以及异格大哥泡改成6天一产
v3.0.5：修复绩泡泡的bug，重修部分描述
v3.0.4:把颉泡泡价格改成444400，这样就没那么大平衡了（，另外添加沙漠节的替换内容
V3.0.2：修复已知bug 增加了四个新的龙泡泡颉（厉钱），坎诺特（古物），望异格（黄金动物饼干），易异格（制造品）
，优化了部分龙泡泡的价格和产出（如黍泡泡的高阶产出，黍异格产出水果等），添加了厉钱（由颉泡泡生产。也可以马龙处买。颉泡泡蛋只能从望处获取
v3.0.1:给龙泡泡打大折，具体可以看下面！另外用了绘图软件中粗略的加边，你可以自行选择是否加边。
v3.0.0:可能是最后更新。添加了其它的龙泡泡们。具体可以看下面的简介。以及降低一些龙泡泡的购买价格和龙泡泡的生长时间调整为12天。另将龙泡泡npc分出来。

山山兔：[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42262]42262[/url]
其它龙泡泡系列模组：龙泡泡美化包DragonBeans Arts：[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40412]40413[/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38308]
[/url]黍泡泡农夫Shu Bean Farmer：﻿[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40412]40412[/url]

龙泡泡的默认成年时间为12天。部分龙泡泡为1天。
1. 朔泡泡（畜棚），12,000金，每天生产  
   朔泡泡，习武的泡泡。朔泡泡很壮，只能住在畜棚里面。每两天将自己抓到的当季的鱼赠于你。偶尔会给教你战术技巧，还可以产出所有龙泡泡蛋。 
   默认产出为鱼类（河豚、鳀鱼、金枪鱼）及战斗季刊；豪华产出增加特殊鱼类（大海参、石鱼、冰柱鱼等）和所有龙泡泡蛋。
2. 望泡泡，12,122金，每6天生产  
   望泡泡，善于谋略的泡泡。在人间拥有无数个分身。每六天会教给你一个谋略知识，提高你的天赋。 
   默认产出为随机书籍（如古代珍宝鉴定指南、小巷自助餐、捕蟹秘籍等）和颉泡泡蛋；豪华产出增加酱料女皇烹饪秘籍和望泡泡分身蛋。
3. 令泡泡，900金，每天生产  
   令泡泡，爱喝酒的泡泡。会把自己喝的酒分享给你。每两天分享一瓶她爱喝的酒。 
   默认产出为随机酒类（果酒、淡啤酒、啤酒、蜂蜜酒）；豪华产出增加令泡泡蛋、令泡泡珍藏的酒和虾鸡尾酒。
4. 均泡泡，500金，每天生产  
   均泡泡，律法、自然与音乐的泡泡。每天都会将大自然孕育的物件赠与给你。 
   默认产出为随机自然产物（蓝莓、蔓越莓、美洲大树莓、香味浆果、葡萄等）和古物；豪华产出增加均泡泡蛋。
5. 颉泡泡，44,440金，每天生产  
   默认产出为随机“钱币”物品（战血流、遇良弈、恣狂情、法与律、一?落、神农守、待机缘、梦奇物、凡物变、两江春、画人间、隐市忧）。
6. 黍泡泡，1,000金，每2天生产  
   黍泡泡，爱种菜的泡泡，耕地之神。每两天会给你一些当季的农场作物作为赠礼，冬季怕你收成不好，会把自己保存的作物都给你。 
   默认产出随季节变化：春季为花椰菜、甘蓝菜、防风草、土豆、大黄、草莓；夏季为蓝莓、啤酒花、甜瓜、西红柿、菠萝、芋头、杨桃；秋季为苋菜、小白菜、蔓越莓、茄子、葡萄、南瓜、山药、宝石甜莓；冬季为霜瓜。豪华产出增加上古水果和黍泡泡蛋。
7. 绩泡泡，77,788金，每天生产  
   绩泡泡，经商的泡泡。每天都会将自己的宝物或者布匹赠与给你。 
   默认产出为晶球、冰封晶球、岩浆晶球、万象晶球、布料和谜之盒；豪华产出改为绩泡泡蛋、古物宝藏、黄金谜之盒和金色椰子。
8. 易泡泡，28,888金，每天生产  
   易泡泡，搞土木的泡泡。每天都会给你建设农场需要的材料，或者是把自己加班剩余的咖啡送给你。 
   默认产出为咖啡、铜锭、铁锭、金锭和精炼石英；豪华产出改为三倍浓缩咖啡、铱锭、放射性矿锭和易泡泡蛋。
9. 年泡泡，450金，每天生产  
   年泡泡，爱吃辣和爱电影的泡泡。每两天给你一次辣椒或者锻造用的煤炭。等等，年泡泡下面的是电影票？ 
   默认产出为辣椒、电影票和煤炭；豪华产出增加年泡泡蛋。
10. 方泡泡，10,000金，每天生产  
    方泡泡，懂得人类医学的泡泡。每天都会将自己配制的药让你的农场生活过得舒服一点。 
    默认产出为药水（生命药水、能量滋补水等）；豪华产出增加方泡泡蛋。
11. 夕泡泡（畜棚），2,500金，每14天生产  
    夕泡泡，转行做蛋塑的泡泡。每半个月将自己的作品赠于你。 
    默认产出为随机夕泡泡蛋塑艺术品（“岁家三姐妹”、“界园三兄弟”、“家庭与责任”）；豪华产出增加夕泡泡蛋。
12. 余泡泡，12,000金，每天生产  
    余泡泡，爱做饭的泡泡。每天都会给你做一次饭。 
    默认产出为随机料理（涵盖游戏内大部分料理及余泡泡料理）；豪华产出增加余泡泡蛋和更高级的食物、调味料。
13. 九色泡，999,990金，每天生产  
    常人所不能寻觅到的珍惜泡泡。但是当你愿意以真金寻觅时，她便会来到你的跟前，以同等价值的物品帮助你。每天赠与你一个五彩碎片和魔法糖冰棍。 
    默认产出为魔法糖冰棍或五彩碎片。
14. 宝妈朔泡泡（畜棚），1,212金，每12天生产  
    宝妈朔泡泡，照顾所有龙泡泡蛋们。每十二天随机生出一个龙泡泡蛋。大哥还真是好妈妈呢。 
    默认产出为随机龙泡泡蛋（望泡泡蛋、令泡泡蛋、黍泡泡蛋等）。
15. 二哥望泡泡，12,000金，每天生产  
    岁家二哥泡，对龙泡泡们相当了解的龙泡泡。每天产出一个金色动物饼干。易泡泡评价：我们的好二哥！ 
    默认产出为金色动物饼干。
16. 春日黍泡泡，500金，每天生产  
    春日黍泡泡，为了感谢你的付出，每天送你一朵小花花和水果~——不过绩泡泡会对你有点生气。 
    默认产出为随机春季水果、蔬菜和花卉（如苹果、香蕉、蓝莓、黄水仙、夏季亮片等）。
17. 奸商绩泡泡，378金，每天生产  
    奸商绩泡泡，懂得用“易与”处世的原则。每天随机给你一个星露谷内的物品。黍泡泡友情劝说：不要上小绩的当哦。 
    默认产出为全游戏随机物品（几乎包含所有物品ID，从基础资源到稀有物品）。
18. 界园易泡泡（畜棚），8,888金，每天生产  
    界园易泡泡，搭载更强的移动工具，为你提供农场需要的打造品。 
    默认产出为农场实用工具与图腾（传送图腾、各类洒水器、蟹笼、野炊工具、银河之魂等）。
19. 捣蛋年泡泡（畜棚），111,110金，每天生产  
    捣蛋年泡泡，私藏很多炸弹！赶紧交出来——捣蛋的年泡泡会在夕的管教下每天会比较“老实”的交出一个炸弹。夕泡泡表示：没有我你的农场可就要被年泡泡炸了！ 
    默认产出为樱桃炸弹、炸弹或爆炸弹丸；豪华产出变为炸弹和超级炸弹。
20. 大厨余泡泡，1,260金，每天生产  
    大厨余泡泡，对厨艺相当精湛的余泡泡。每天都会给你三选一做一顿余味居风味。年泡泡四十二星评价：余味居真的非常好吃！ 
    默认产出为随机余泡泡特色料理（家常小炒、橘红酥、长寿面三选一）。
21. 终末地泡泡甲，25,000金，每6天生产  
    终末地泡泡甲，庄方宜最喜欢的龙泡泡之一。来自武陵城喜欢一草一木的泡泡。每四天交给你一个树浆。 
    默认产出为枫糖浆、橡树树脂或松焦油；豪华产出增加神秘糖浆。
22. 终末地泡泡乙，20,000金，每天生产  
    终末地泡泡乙，庄方宜最喜欢的龙泡泡之二。来自武陵城喜欢科技的泡泡。每两天给你一个电池或者是精炼石英。 
    默认产出为电池组或精炼石英。
23. 坎诺特泡，300金，每天生产  
    很诡异的不明商人，伪装成龙泡泡的样子。只要是文明里出现过的，他就给予你。 
    默认产出为随机古物。
24. 龙泡泡一家（畜棚），1,212金，每天生产  
    龙泡泡一家，牢不可分的一家！给你生产所有龙泡泡物品！ 
    默认产出为全模组物品随机（包含所有龙泡泡蛋、特色料理、钱币以及大量原版物品）。


1.  Shuo Bean (Barn), 12,000g, produces every days.
    Shuo Bean, a kungfu Bean. Shuo Bean is very strong and can only live in a Barn. Gives you the fish she catches (seasonal) every two days. Occasionally teaches you tactical skills and can also produce all DragonBean eggs.
    Default products: Fish (Pufferfish, Anchovy, Tuna) and Combat Journal; Deluxe products add special fish (Sea Cucumber, Stonefish, Ice Pip, etc.) and all DragonBean eggs.

2.  Wang Bean, 12,122g, produces every 6 days.
    Wang Bean, a strategist Bean. Has countless clones in the human world. Teaches you a piece of strategic knowledge every six days, improving your skills.
    Default products: Random books (e.g., Ancient Treasure Appraisal Guide, Alleyway Buffet, Crab Fishing Guide) and Jie Bean Egg; Deluxe products add Queen of Sauce Cookbook and Wang Bean Clone Egg.

3.  Ling Bean, 900g, produces every days.
    Ling Bean, a Bean who loves drinking. Shares the wine she drinks with you. Shares a bottle of wine every two days.
    Default products: Random alcohol (Fruit Wine, Pale Ale, Beer, Mead); Deluxe products add Ling Bean Egg, Ling Bean's treasured wine, and Shrimp Cocktail.

4.  Yun Bean, 500g, produces every days.
    Yun Bean, a Bean of nature, law and music. Gives you objects born from nature every day.
    Default products: Random natural produce (Blueberry, Cranberry, Salmonberry, Spice Berry, Grape, etc.) and Artifacts; Deluxe products add Yun Bean Egg.

5.  Jie Bean, 44,440g, produces every days.
    Default products: Random "Qian" items ("Bloodshed Spill", "Weiqi Chance", "Wild Passion", "Law and Order", "First ? Falls", "Shennong Watches", "Biding Time", "Dream Curio", "Universal Change", "Two-River Spring", "Painter's Realm", "City Concerns").

6.  Shu Bean, 1,000g, produces every days.
    Shu Bean, a Bean who loves growing vegetables, Goddess of Tilled Land. Gives you some seasonal farm crops as a gift every two days. Worried about your harvest in winter, she gives you all the crops she has preserved.
    Default products vary by season: Spring - Cauliflower, Kale, Parsnip, Potato, Rhubarb, Strawberry; Summer - Blueberry, Hops, Melon, Tomato, Pineapple, Taro, Starfruit; Fall - Amaranth, Bok Choy, Cranberry, Eggplant, Grape, Pumpkin, Yam, Sweet Gem Berry; Winter - Frost Melon. Deluxe products add Ancient Fruit and Shu Bean Egg.

7.  Ji Bean, 77,788g, produces daily.
    Ji Bean, a merchant Bean. Gives you his treasures or cloth every day.
    Default products: Geode, Frozen Geode, Magma Geode, Omni Geode, Cloth, and Mystery Box; Deluxe products change to Ji Bean Egg, Artifact Trove, Golden Mystery Box, and Golden Coconut.

8.  Yi Bean, 28,888g, produces daily.
    Yi Bean, an architect Bean. Gives you materials needed for farm construction every day, or gives you his overtime coffee.
    Default products: Coffee, Copper Bar, Iron Bar, Gold Bar, Refined Quartz; Deluxe products change to Triple Shot Espresso, Iridium Bar, Radioactive Bar, and Yi Bean Egg.

9.  Nian Bean, 450g, produces every days.
    Nian Bean, a Bean who loves spicy food and movies. Gives you peppers or coal for forging every two days. Wait, are those movie tickets under Nian Bean?
    Default products: Hot Pepper, Movie Ticket, Coal; Deluxe products add Nian Bean Egg.

10. Fang Bean, 10,000g, produces daily.
    Fang Bean, a Bean who understands human medicine. Gives you the medicine she prepares to make your farm life more comfortable every day.
    Default products: Potions (Life Elixir, Energy Tonic, etc.); Deluxe products add Fang Bean Egg.

11. Dusk Bean (Barn), 2,500g, produces every 14 days.
    Dusk Bean, a Bean switched career to egg sculpting. Gives you her artwork every half month.
    Default products: Random Dusk Bean egg sculpture artworks ("Sui Family Sisters", "The Sui's Garden Three", "Family and Responsibilities"); Deluxe products add Dusk Bean Egg.

12. Yu Bean, 12,000g, produces daily.
    Yu Bean, a Bean who loves cooking. Cooks a meal for you every day.
    Default products: Random cooked dishes (covers most dishes in-game and Yu Bean's dishes); Deluxe products add Yu Bean Egg and higher-tier food/seasonings.

13. Nine-colored Bean, 999,990g, produces daily.
    A rare Bean that ordinary people cannot find. But when you are willing to search with ambition, she will come before you and help you with items of equal value. Gives you one Prismatic Shard and one Magic Rock Candy every day.
    Default products: Magic Rock Candy or Prismatic Shard.

14. Mother Shuo Bean (Barn), 1,212g, produces every 12 days.
    Mother Shuo Bean, takes care of all DragonBean eggs. Every twelve days, randomly produces one DragonBean egg. Big brother really is a good mother.
    Default products: Random DragonBean egg (Wang Bean Egg, Ling Bean Egg, Shu Bean Egg, etc.).

15. Erge Bean of the Sui Family, 12,000g, produces daily.
    Erge Bean of the Sui Family, a DragonBean who knows the DragonBeans well. Produces one golden animal cracker daily. Yi Bean's review: Our good Erge!
    Default products: Golden Animal Cracker.

16. Spring Shu Bean, 500g, produces daily.
    Spring Shu Bean, to thank you for your efforts, gives you a small flower and fruit every day~ — Though Ji Bean will be a bit angry with you.
    Default products: Random spring fruits, vegetables, and flowers (e.g., Apple, Banana, Blueberry, Daffodil, Summer Spangle, etc.).

17. Tricky Merchant Ji Bean, 378g, produces daily.
    Tricky Merchant Ji Bean, understands the principle of 'giving and taking'. Gives you a random item from Stardew Valley every day. Shu Bean kindly advises: Don't fall for Little Ji's tricks.
    Default products: Random item from the entire game (covers almost all item IDs, from basic resources to rare items).

18. Sui's Garden's Yi Bean (Barn), 8,888g, produces daily.
    Sui's Garden's Yi Bean, equipped with enhanced mobile tools, provides you with crafted items needed for the farm.
    Default products: Farm utility tools and totems (Warp Totems, various Sprinklers, Crab Pot, Campfire, Galaxy Soul, etc.).

19. Mischievous Nian Bean (Barn), 111,110g, produces daily.
    Mischievous Nian Bean, hiding many bombs! Hand them over quickly! Under Dusk's discipline, the mischievous Nian Bean will 'honestly' hand over one bomb every day. Dusk Bean says: Without me, your farm would be blown up by Nian Bean!
    Default products: Cherry Bomb, Bomb, or Explosive Ammo; Deluxe products change to Bomb and Mega Bomb.

20. Chef Yu Bean, 1,260g, produces daily.
    Chef Yu Bean, a Yu Bean who is quite skilled in cooking. Every day, he will give you three options to cook a Yu's Restaurant style meal. Nian Bean's 42-star review: Yu's Restaurant is really delicious!
    Default products: Random Yu Bean specialty dish (Yu Bean's Home-style Stir-fry, Yu Bean's Orange Pastry, Yu Bean's Noodles - choose one of three).

21. Endfield Bean A, 25,000g, produces every 4 days.
    Endfield Bean A, one of Zhuang Fangyi's favorite DragonBeans. A Bean from Wuling City who loves every plant and tree. Gives you one tree sap every four days.
    Default products: Maple Syrup, Oak Resin, or Pine Tar; Deluxe products add Mystic Syrup.

22. Endfield Bean B, 20,000g, produces every days.
    Endfield Bean B, another of Zhuang Fangyi's favorite DragonBeans. A Bean from Wuling City who loves technology. Gives you one battery or one refined quartz every two days.
    Default products: Battery Pack or Refined Quartz.

23. Cannot Bean, 300g, produces daily.
    A mysterious unknown merchant disguised as DragonBeans. He'll give you something that has ever appeared in civilization.
    Default products: Random Artifact.

24. DragonBeans Family (Barn), 1,212g, produces daily.
    The DragonBeans Family, one closely bound family! Produces all DragonBeans items for you!
    Default products: Random items from the entire mod (includes all DragonBean eggs, specialty dishes, "Qian" items, and many vanilla items).
